title: Keryx MCP Client: stdio client, codex elicitation handling, tool-registry bridge

AC1.note: src/mcp-client/client.smoke.test.ts: live handshake against real codex-cli 0.147.0, re-verified this session with KERYX_ALLOW_REAL_SUBPROCESS=1 (1 pass)

AC2.note: fixtures/mcp-client/codex/approve.jsonl+deny.jsonl (captured:true from a real codex mcp-server run), replayed offline by src/mcp-client/fixtures.test.ts

AC3.note: src/mcp-client/live-elicitation.smoke.test.ts: superviseCodexMcpRun driven against a real spawned codex mcp-server, both approve (file created) and decline (file never created) cases; re-verified this session, both pass (92.71s decline, within its own 90s internal timeout)

AC4.note: fixtures/mcp-client/codex/timeout.jsonl (captured:true, reproduces openai/codex#11816's turn_aborted/reason:interrupted) + supervise-mcp.test.ts's elicitation-answer-timeout suite (requestApproval that never resolves still completes, recorded as ElicitationHandledRecord.timedOut:true, not a hang)

AC5.note: buildElicitationResponse declines without a decision field for any uncorrelated elicitation (no sibling codex/event, or empty available_decisions) - the live-reconfirmed manifestation of openai/codex#23383; fixtures/mcp-client/codex/malformed-empty-content.SYNTHETIC.jsonl + supervise-mcp.test.ts/elicitation.test.ts coverage

AC6.note: supervise-mcp.ts calls resolveApprovalDecision unconditionally for every elicitation before responding; supervise-mcp.test.ts asserts the call and gateDecision for both auto and ask modes, re-confirmed live in live-elicitation.smoke.test.ts (gateDecision:"ask" asserted in both live cases)

AC7.note: src/mcp-client/credential-boundary.test.ts: no credential-shaped env/identifier read in src/mcp-client/ or supervise-mcp.ts; child env is forwarded verbatim from the caller (McpSpawnOptions.env), same D-01 boundary keryx-external-agent-runtime already verifies

AC8.note: src/harness/external/agent-event-bridge.test.ts is byte-for-byte unmodified (git diff main -- that file is empty) and passes 24/24; the elicitation exchange records to ElicitationHandledRecord/elicitations, never to ExternalEvent

AC9.note: elicitation.test.ts's classifyElicitationRisk suite: a single fixture (sudo cat .../auth.json-shaped command) independently proves destructive:true and credentials:true via reused isDestructiveCommand/touchesAgentCredentials, feeding resolveApprovalDecision exactly like classifyPatchRisk does for write
